description: Measures the time to launch a single empty kernel (no work), so the time is pure dispatch / grid-scheduling / completion cost. Sweeping num_blocks shows how overhead grows with grid size; block_size is swept as a non-scaling parameter. Reports launch_sync_us (host wall-clock launch+synchronize round trip per launch) and gpu_event_us (GPU event time bracketing each launch), both averaged over a fixed number of iterations.

scaling_param.name: num_blocks
scaling_param.description: Number of thread blocks in the (empty) grid; primary axis for launch/scheduling overhead

non_scaling_params.name: block_size
non_scaling_params.description: Threads per block in the empty grid
